summary: Fill the board with cheap units, build the second gate immediately, and keep pressure on gates and the enemy summoner.
notes: Summon aggressively: more bodies means more value from Pile On, Enrage the Horde and Sneak.
The second gate is the priority build; a delayed gate is only acceptable to Sly Sneeks into enemy territory.
Play commons rather than discarding them for magic: the deck is cheap and magic is not the bottleneck.
Pressure matters more than perfect trades, but do not leave units where they die for free.
